At Chime, we believe in the power of our product to help people lead healthier financial lives. The Trust & Safety team is tasked with keeping our members’ accounts safe, providing them uninterrupted access to their money, and minimizing the company’s risk exposure and fraud loss.
We are looking for a Product Manager to lead product strategy and execution for Transaction Risk Decisioning at Chime .
This team builds the decisioning systems and product experiences that help Chime evaluate transaction risk in real time across card payments, peer-to-peer payments, bank transfers, and other money movement surfaces. The team partners closely with engineering, analytics, risk strategy, operations, and platform teams to reduce fraud, improve approval rates, and make risk outcomes clearer and more recoverable for members.
For our members, this space is deeply personal. A risk decision can determine whether a card transaction goes through, whether money movement succeeds, whether a suspicious action is stopped in time, and whether a member feels protected or unfairly blocked. The best products in this area make safety visible without making everyday banking harder. They keep friction targeted to risky behavior, not normal behavior, and turn declines or interventions into understandable, recoverable experiences.
What this team owns
This is a high-leverage role at the intersection of risk, growth, trust, and product quality. The team owns outbound transaction risk across card authorization, ACH, peer-to-peer, outbound transfers, and related surfaces — protecting a large share of Chime's revenue while minimizing fraud and disputes and enabling healthy growth.
In this role, you can expect to
Drive strategy to reduce transaction declines and increase purchase volume authorization rates — directly impacting members' experience with Chime, and helping Chime's revenue and purchase volume growth
Launch new controls for an emerging fraud pattern across a money movement rail
Redesign a risky decline flow so more good members recover successfully while bad actors are still contained,
Work cross functionally with analysts, data science, Compliance, Legal and engineers to improve the quality of risk signals flowing into a decision checkpoint,
Partner with member support teams to make a confusing risk outcome understandable and actionable for members,
Help launch new financial products safely by designing the right safeguards, fallbacks, and monitoring.
To thrive in this role, you have
5+ years of experience as a Product Manager
Deep expertise in payments risk — you understand how card networks operate, including Visa and Mastercard transaction rules, authorization reason codes, dispute and chargeback frameworks, and decline return codes (e.g., Do Not Honor, Insufficient Funds, Card Activity Limit). You can hold a substantive conversation with a risk strategist, a network partner, or an issuer processor about why a transaction declined and what can be done about it
Proven ability to think strategically about purchase volume and authorization rates , you've connected decisioning logic to revenue outcomes and can frame risk tradeoffs in terms of business impact, not just fraud loss
A track record of bringing thought leadership to hard, ambiguous problems - you don't just execute on a roadmap, you shape it. You can articulate a compelling vision for how the transaction experience should work and build alignment across engineering, risk, compliance, and leadership
A strong product mindset and the ability to translate complex risk and platform challenges into clear strategy and execution
Experience operating in systems with significant policy, operational, and data dependencies
The ability to engage fluently across member journeys, policy behavior, experiment design, and platform capabilities
Strong customer empathy and a track record of turning user insights into product decisions — with a particular sensitivity to how declines and friction moments affect member trust and retention
Strong analytical skills and experience applying machine learning and AI methodologies
Deep curiosity and a strong sense of ownership
Experience working in a fast-growing, cross-functional environment
A passion for helping members lead healthy financial lives

We're looking for a Product Manager to lead the strategy, implementation, and evolution of our SAP platform. In this role, you'll define the product vision for SAP as the foundation of Finance operations while building the intelligent automation layer that transforms manual, transaction-heavy processes into streamlined, AI-powered workflows.

Working closely with Finance and Engineering, you'll shape the future of finance operations by combining the strength of SAP with agentic AI to deliver a simpler, more automated, and more intelligent experience for Finance users.
The Opportunity
SAP will serve as the foundation for Databricks' core finance processes, including Record-to-Report, Source-to-Pay, and Order-to-Cash. As the SAP Product Manager, you will shape how Finance users interact with these processes by building an intelligent, AI-powered agentic layer on top of SAP.

Rather than navigating multiple systems and performing manual tasks, Finance teams will rely on AI-driven workflows that automate routine work, surface the right insights, and guide users through exceptions and approvals.

Your mission is to combine the strength of SAP with the power of the Databricks AI to create a modern, highly automated finance experience that enables the business to scale.

Own the SAP & Intelligent Automation Strategy: Lead the product strategy and roadmap for Databricks' SAP platform, ensuring it serves as the foundation for scalable, best-in-class finance operations. Drive SAP implementations, platform evolution, and business process transformation while defining the automation roadmap that leverages AI and agentic workflows to simplify user experiences, reduce manual effort, and improve operational efficiency.
Lead the AI & Agentic Layer: Design, build, and deploy intelligent agentic workflows on top of SAP, partnering with engineering and data teams on the orchestration, retrieval, and guardrail patterns that make agents safe to act on financial and procurement data.
Unify SAP Data in the Lakehouse: Own the product requirements for getting SAP data into Databricks, including ingestion, semantic and master data modeling, lineage, and governance, so that AI, analytics, and downstream applications work from one trusted definition of the business.
Serve as Product Owner in Delivery: Own the backlog and acceptance criteria, run prioritization and release planning with internal and partner engineering teams, and drive readiness, cutover, adoption, and change management for what you ship.
Domain Leadership: Act as the primary product leader for core SAP domain, and as the connective tissue across the SAP ecosystem, including BTP, Integration Suite, and the non-SAP systems around it.
Execute and Measure: Define success metrics (process cycle time, touchless transaction rate, automation accuracy, adoption, close efficiency, cost-to-serve) and use data-driven insights to guide rapid iteration.
Influence and Collaborate: Align Finance, Procurement, Enterprise Architecture, Security, and senior leadership around the automated product vision, and evangelize the roadmap in company-wide productivity and AI discussions.

7+ years of product management or product ownership experience , with a proven track record leading enterprise ERP initiatives at scale, including at least one large SAP implementation, S/4HANA migration, or major module rollout.
Specialist Domain Expertise: Deep functional background in SAP and the business processes it runs, with concrete experience in one or more of record-to-report, source-to-pay, or order-to-cash , and working fluency in the adjacent areas and in master data governance.
Agentic Automation & Advanced AI: Hands-on experience or a strong technical understanding of agentic automation , LLM orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation, and evaluation, with clear judgment about where AI belongs in a controlled, auditable ERP process and where it does not.
Data Fluency: Strong understanding of building on modern data platforms, including SAP data extraction and modeling, pipelines, semantic layers, and the practical work of making ERP data usable for analytics and AI.
Strategic & Product Thought Leadership: Demonstrated ability to own a product domain end-to-end, linking automation outcomes directly to finance and operations goals rather than to feature delivery.
Governance Rigor: Working knowledge of SAP authorizations, SoD, SOX and audit requirements, and modern enterprise governance practice, and the ability to design automation that satisfies them.
Ambiguity Champion: Highly comfortable leading through extreme ambiguity, managing complex stakeholder landscapes across business and IT, and collaborating directly with engineering pods to build applications from scratch.

Experience developing custom applications or automation layers on data platforms (such as Databricks) that extend or sit alongside SAP.
Familiarity with the SAP AI and extension stack, including BTP, and AI Core, and a clear point of view on build-versus-adopt tradeoffs against a Databricks native approach.
Hands-on knowledge of SAP integration surfaces and their limitations, including OData and REST APIs, CDS views and Datasphere.

We’re looking for a Principal Product Manager to guide the vision, strategy, and execution for Identity Threat Detection and Response (ITDR) within Elastic Security. Attackers not only break in - they log in. Identity is now a major target for attacks. These attacks can happen in on-premises setups, cloud environments, or with self-directed agents. Detecting and responding to identity-based attacks is essential for any modern Security Operations Center (SOC).
In this high-impact role, you will define how Elastic detects, investigates, and responds to identity-based threats, building on our Entity Analytics and Entity Store foundation to deliver a credible, differentiated ITDR function.

You will also own the roadmap for securing non-human and AI agent identities within Elastic Security, one of the fastest-growing and least-governed attack surfaces in the enterprise.

You will work at the intersection of identity, detection engineering, and AI, partnering with threat researchers, data scientists, and engineers, and evangelizing our approach to a global community of security practitioners.
What You Will Be Doing
Define and own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for a credible ITDR function within Elastic Security, evolving our Entity Analytics and Entity Store foundation from behavioral analytics into an identity-defense outcome.
Manage the plan for non-human and AI agent identities in Elastic Security. This involves modeling service accounts, workloads, secrets, and self-directed agents as important identities. Each identity will have its own behavior standards, ownership, and lifecycle. You will also establish how to detect identities that operate continuously and at machine scale.
Work with threat research and detection engineering. Focus on identity-specific threats. These threats include credential access, privilege escalation, and identity-based lateral movement. They also involve the abuse of identity providers and tokens. Ensure that these threats relate to real-world adversary tactics.
Drive the response and containment strategy. This is the 'R' in ITDR. Turn detections into action. Use identity-system integrations and automated responses. Make sure there is human oversight for important actions.
Work closely with our enterprise customers. Collaborate with security operations teams, sales, and solution architects. Your goal is to understand the requirements for identity attacks. You will also discuss priorities and clarify product needs.
Work with the design team to develop investigation and response experiences. These experiences will emphasize identity in the analyst workflow. Integrate identity signals with endpoint, cloud, and network data in the SIEM and XDR functions of our security operations platform.
Gain deep knowledge of the identity-security market. Know its major trends and the changing threat landscape. Use this information to develop a unique strategy and engage with analysts.
Be the product expert and evangelize Elastic's identity capabilities through content such as blog posts, talks, and open community interaction.

Extensive Experience: 10+ years of experience in product management or solution delivery for security products such as SIEM, XDR, EDR, identity security, or detection and response. A consistent record of leading sophisticated, data-intensive products from inception through launch and iterative growth.
Identity Security Depth: A solid knowledge of identity-based attack techniques and the identity fabric. This includes Active Directory, cloud identity providers, SSO, OAuth, and privileged access. It also involves knowing how identity threats can occur in both on-premises and cloud environments. Knowledge of ITDR as a discipline and with entity behavioral analytics (UEBA).
You need to be fluent in non-human identities. This includes service accounts, workloads, secrets, and AI agents. You should also understand why traditional human-identity rules don't apply to identities that act independently and continuously.
AI and ML Fluency: Deep technical comprehension of the AI/ML landscape, including behavioral analytics, anomaly detection, LLMs, and agentic systems. You are comfortable working closely with data scientists and engineers, and you treat AI agents both as a subject to be secured and as a tool that consumes identity context.
Bias to action: You are able to advance fast and quickly learn from experiments and tests. You utilize AI tools to help accelerate your processes and bring clarity to your decisions.
Management and Influence: Demonstrated ability to lead across a matrixed organization, align multiple stakeholders toward a common vision, and drive execution in a dynamic, remote-first environment. You operate with the autonomy and judgment expected of a principal-level product leader.
Communication Excellence: Outstanding spoken and written communication skills and practices. You can distill complex detection engineering and identity concepts into compelling narratives for both technical and non-technical audiences, including executive leadership.
Customer Obsession: An interest for industry trends and a commitment to solving real-world customer problems. You are an advocate for the security analyst and detection engineer, and you are focused on building products that help defenders stay ahead of identity-based threats.

Reddit is looking for a Group Product Manager to lead the product management of our Finance SaaS portfolio, our systems that run treasury, planning, procure-to-pay, record-to-report, quote-to-cash, payroll, and equity.

This is a player-coach role: you'll coach and manage a small team of SaaS product managers who each own a domain of Finance's application stack, while personally owning your own set of applications as a player.

This role serves as the orchestration layer for Finance and AI Transformation, requiring you to advise senior executives, influence strategic direction, and navigate complex matrixed environments to translate high-level strategy into measurable business outcomes.
You set the product vision and roadmap across the Finance SaaS landscape, decide what gets built and bought, drive adoption, and own the vendor relationships that underpin the stack. You partner closely with the Enterprise Architecture & Engineering team. They own how systems are built and integrated; you own what we build, why, and when.
You will be at the forefront of our AI-first finance strategy, championing the next generation of intelligent automation to redefine efficiency and scalability across our global operations. If you're energized by translating complex finance processes into clean, well-run systems, thrive at the seam between business and technology, and want to both lead a team and stay close to the product yourself, this role is for you.

Product Strategy & Portfolio Ownership
Own the end-to-end product vision and multi-quarter roadmap for Reddit's Finance SaaS portfolio across P2P, R2R, QTC, payroll & equity, and treasury/investments/EPM.
As the lead for Finance & AI Transformation, you are the catalyst for shifting Reddit’s finance teams from manual processes to AI-enabled workflows. This includes championing a “finance engineer” mindset, proactively identifying AI use cases for close automation and anomaly detection, and fostering a culture where data-driven innovation is embedded in our operating model.
Translate Finance's priorities (e.g., close acceleration, scalability, public-company rigor, M&A) into a sequenced, defensible roadmap.
Lead build-vs-buy and vendor selection decisions; serve as the product voice in Finance technology investments alongside the Enterprise Architect.
Define and enforce a consistent product operating model across the team: intake, prioritization, release management, change management, and adoption measurement.
Identify opportunities to improve Finance processes through AI-enabled workflows, reconciliations, anomaly detection, approval copilots, and close automation.
Drive roadmap prioritization using measurable outcomes such as close cycle reduction, automation rates, SOX compliance effectiveness, and Finance productivity improvements.
Establish a single, transparent demand pipeline so Finance stakeholders can see what's planned, in flight, and shipped.
Assess the end-to-end finance processes to identify manual workflows, process gaps, control weaknesses, data quality issues, and opportunities to improve and enable AI-powered solutions..
Create a cross-functional decision framework for Finance capabilities, including clear ownership, intake, prioritization, readiness criteria, and business sign-off.
Identify, design, and launch new features and system capabilities that enhance user efficiency while driving incremental value for the business.
Partner with finance leadership to enable AI use across teams, fundamentally shifting the organization toward a "finance engineer" mindset where finance teams are empowered to build, automate, and innovate within our systems.
Drive end-to-end finance transformation initiatives across Quote-to-Cash (QTC), Procure-to-Pay (P2P), Record-to-Report (R2R), and Hire-to-Retire (H2R), ensuring alignment between process improvements and long-term scalability.
Strategic Orchestration & Influence
Advise senior Finance and Tech leadership on roadmap trade-offs, balancing speed, risk, and long-term impact.
Navigate organizational dynamics to secure alignment across Finance, Tech, and Business partners.
Promote harmony between internal teams and external integration partners by resolving bottlenecks and managing cross-functional dependencies.
Lead a rigorous diligence program to evaluate and optimize system performance, workflows, and adoption metrics to strengthen operational quality.
Team Leadership
Directly manage a team of SaaS product managers, each owning a Finance domain (P2P & R2R, QTC, Payroll & Equity).
Set clear direction and priorities for each domain, and create space for deep, high-quality product work.
Develop your team's craft through roadmap review, stakeholder coaching, and regular 1:1s focused on growth.
Serve as an escalation point and thought partner when your PMs hit ambiguity, contention over priorities, or cross-functional friction.
Build the bench: define the team's coverage model, identify gaps, and grow the function as Finance scales.

Maintain direct ownership over a specific set of applications, leading their product roadmaps and managing key stakeholder relationships.
This isn't a purely managerial role: you'll run intake, prioritize enhancements, manage releases, and partner directly with Finance and the Eng team to deliver in your own portfolio.
Stay close enough to the work to credibly coach your team and make sharp product tradeoffs.
Vendor and Demand Management
Own Finance SaaS vendor relationships at the portfolio level: renewals, SLAs, roadmap influence, escalations, and spend rationalization.
Bring a demand-management mindset to intake; help Finance stakeholders articulate needs, size effort, and sequence work effectively rather than absorbing every request.
Partner with Procurement and Finance leadership on tooling spend, contract timing, and consolidation opportunities.
Maintain a clear view of total cost of ownership and license utilization across the stack.
Stakeholder Partnership
Act as the primary product liaison for Finance leadership, translating business requirements into roadmap decisions and communicating tradeoffs clearly.
Partner with FP&A, Technical Accounting, Revenue, Treasury, Payroll, and Finance Operations to understand pain points and proactively surface system improvements.
Work hand-in-glove with the Enterprise Architect and Engineering team to land integrations, data quality, and technical delivery against the product roadmap.
Support M&A activity (e.g., systems due diligence, gap analysis, integration sequencing, and adoption planning for acquired entities).

Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.
You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries.

Physical AI only goes as far as power and the internet can reach. Verkada's Connectivity products push that boundary, securing people and property in remote and edge environments. Our team brings Verkada's AI threat detection, deterrence, and operational insights anywhere you need them, allowing our cameras and other security solutions to be deployed in locations without existing internet or power.
We are looking for a Lead Product Manager to own Verkada's edge products: the Gateway product line and the hardware/software platform behind our Security Trailers. Your mission is to bring network + power to any device, anywhere, and make edge products the backbone of physical AI beyond the building.
We are committed to a thriving in-office culture. This role requires you to work onsite at our HQ in San Mateo, CA.

Healthcare should work for patients, but it doesn’t. In their time of need, they call down outdated insurance directories. Then wait on hold. Then wait weeks for the privilege of a visit. Then wait in a room solely designed for waiting. Then wait for a surprise bill. In any other consumer industry, the companies delivering such a poor customer experience would not survive. But in healthcare, patients lack market power. Which means they are expected to accept the unacceptable.
Zocdoc’s mission is to give power to the patient. To do that, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace that makes it easy to find and book in-person or virtual care in all 50 states, across +200 specialties and +12k insurance plans. By giving patients the ability to see and choose, we give them power.

In doing so, we can make healthcare work like every other consumer sector, where businesses compete for customers, not the other way around. In time, this will drive quality up and prices down.
We’re 18 years old and the leader in our space, but we are still just getting started. If you like solving important, complex problems alongside deeply thoughtful, driven, and collaborative teammates, read on.

As a Staff Product Manager for Payments within our Practice Solutions business unit, you will define and build the products that help healthcare practices manage the financial side of patient care.
You will own critical parts of the payments and revenue cycle experience, including how practices understand patient responsibility, collect payments, reconcile transactions, and connect payment activity to claims and remittance data. You will work across complex healthcare workflows involving patients, providers, payors, clearinghouses, and technology partners.
This is a zero to one product leadership role. You will identify unmet customer needs, define the product strategy, and build new capabilities from the ground up. You will need to be equally comfortable setting a long term vision and getting into the details with engineering, design, operations, finance, and go to market teams to bring an early stage product to market and scale it.
You’ll enjoy this role if you are…
Personally motivated by improving the healthcare system for both patients and providers
Energized by the complexity of healthcare payments, insurance, claims, and revenue cycle workflows
A builder who loves taking products from zero to one and turning ambiguous opportunities into real products customers use
Energized by startup environments where speed, ownership, resourcefulness, and judgment matter
Comfortable moving between long term strategy, detailed workflow design, technical conversations, customer research, and execution
The kind of person who can turn a broad opportunity into clear crawl, walk, and run solutions

Driving impact through cross-functional collaboration, ensuring alignment between engineering, design, operations, and go-to-market partners
Developing a deep understanding of the financial workflows, pain points, and goals of healthcare practices through customer research, data analysis, and close partnership with internal teams
Defining the long term product vision and strategy for payments within Practice Solutions
Rolling up your sleeves to drive execution with deep complexity and at scale

6+ years of product management experience building B2B products

At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.
One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

Are you passionate about turning data and AI into decisions that matter? Do you thrive at the intersection of business, analytics, and product development? If so, this is your opportunity to help shape the future of Life & Health Re through innovative analytical products that drive real operational impact.

As an Analytics Product Expert, you will be at the heart of a mission to make data and AI work harder for the business. You will bridge the gap between Life & Health Re's operational teams and product delivery, ensuring that analytical products are not just built - but adopted, valued, and embedded into everyday decision-making.

From shaping product roadmaps to facilitating stakeholder workshops, your work will directly influence how Swiss Re uses analytics and AI to drive operational excellence.

* Partner with business stakeholders to deeply understand operational challenges, question existing ways of working, and translate complex business needs into clear product requirements, user journeys, and analytical use cases
* Support Product Owners in defining and evolving product roadmaps, prioritising enhancements, and shaping new capabilities based on business value, strategic priorities, and user feedback
* Collaborate cross-functionally with Data Engineering, Data Science, UX, and IT teams to ensure business requirements are clearly understood, accurately scoped, and successfully delivered
* Drive product adoption through user testing, demonstrations, documentation, and change management activities - ensuring analytical products become genuinely embedded in day-to-day operational decision-making
* Continuously identify opportunities to enhance business intelligence, improve user experience, and strengthen operational decision support through the smart application of analytics and AI
* Contribute to strategic analytics products such as L&H Nexus, Operational Health Workbench, and AI-enabled solutions that connect business processes, data, and intelligence

The Operational Analytics & Intelligence team sits within Data & Operational Excellence and is a global team responsible for generating end-to-end operational insights and driving decision-making through data, analytics, and AI across Life & Health Re.

We play a key role in delivering on the strategic priorities of End-to-end Operational Excellence and Make Data Matter. Our team develops and evolves strategic analytical products that connect business processes, data, and AI to enable measurable business impact - and we're growing.

You are a curious, collaborative, and commercially minded professional who loves making complexity simple. You bring a strong analytical mindset combined with excellent communication skills, and you know how to bring people along on the journey - from initial problem framing through to product adoption. You are energised by working in dynamic, cross-functional environments and are genuinely excited about the potential of AI and analytics to transform how organisations operate.

The story behind this role
At Cheesecake Labs , product work usually starts before things are fully defined.
We’re often brought in when companies are still shaping ideas, validating opportunities, aligning stakeholders, or trying to understand what should actually be built — and why.
That’s why we maintain a network of strong contractor Product Managers we can engage quickly as new projects and client opportunities emerge.
This is not a traditional long-term internal role.
It’s a contractor opportunity designed for people who enjoy navigating ambiguity, collaborating with multidisciplinary teams, and helping turn business problems into valuable digital products across different industries and client contexts.
We’re looking for a Product Manager (Contractor) who combines product thinking, communication, organization, and client management in fast-moving international environments.
Engagement details
Contractor / project-based engagement
Paid in USD
Remote-first
Flexible allocation depending on project availability and fit
Opportunities may vary in duration, scope, and weekly commitment depending on client needs

What this role actually looks like
This is not a “just manage backlog” type of role.

s.h: On a typical project, you might
s.t:
Work with clients and stakeholders to understand business goals, user problems, and product opportunities
Help shape product direction even when requirements, priorities, or product vision are still evolving
Create and organize product backlogs, user stories, business rules, and feature definitions
Work closely with delivery managers, designers, and engineers to define valuable, feasible, and usable solutions
Facilitate alignment across clients, technical teams, and business stakeholders
Participate in product discovery, roadmap discussions, prioritization, and go-to-market conversations
Join product ceremonies and help ensure the product is evolving in the right direction
Some projects will be highly strategic and discovery-oriented.
Others will be much more execution and delivery-focused.
Most are a mix of both.
What tends to work well here
We’ve seen that people who thrive in this type of engagement usually:
Have strong experience managing digital products across web and mobile environments
Feel comfortable navigating ambiguity, evolving priorities, and fast-changing product contexts
Know how to balance business goals, user needs, technical constraints, and delivery realities
Feel totally confident working in English with international clients and teams (calls, discussions, async) — at least advanced level
Operate well across multidisciplinary environments involving product, engineering, design, and delivery teams
Adapt well to consulting-style environments where different projects and industries require fast context-switching
Already use AI as part of their day-to-day workflow — whether for organization, discovery, documentation, research, prioritization, or workflow acceleration
Previous experience in consulting/service environments, enterprise products, or US-based client contexts is a strong plus.
This probably won’t be your thing if

You prefer highly structured environments with very stable scopes and long planning cycles
You’re uncomfortable navigating ambiguity or balancing multiple stakeholders and priorities simultaneously
You prefer operating only at a strategic level without involvement in execution and day-to-day product decisions
You’d rather avoid client-facing conversations or cross-functional collaboration
You rely heavily on mature product structures, large internal product teams, or extensive metrics environments to operate effectively
There’s nothing wrong with any of that — it’s just not how these engagements usually operate.

In einer ersten Phase liegt dein Fokus auf drei zentralen Themen:

* Du definierst gemeinsam mit den Beteiligten verbindliche Mindeststandards für Code, Security und Automatisierung.
* Du unterstützt die Teams im Umgang mit Pipelines und Standards und sorgst dafür, dass diese verständlich, nutzbar und wirksam verankert werden.
In einem nächsten Schritt entwickelst du das System Team gezielt weiter zu einem zentralen Enabler für weitere Teile des Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC):
* Du treibst die Automatisierung über den gesamten Entwicklungs- und Lieferprozess voran.
* Du förderst professionelle Softwareentwicklung mit klaren Standards, wirksamer Automatisierung und einem hohen Reifegrad.
* Du identifizierst Themenfelder mit hohem Nutzen, priorisierst sie und entwickelst sie gemeinsam mit dem Team weiter - zum Beispiel in den Bereichen Testmanagement, Umgebungsmanagement, Release-Management oder Entwicklungsstandards.
* Du schaffst die Grundlage für einheitliche Rahmenbedingungen, Best Practices und wiederverwendbare Lösungen.
* Du sorgst dafür, dass das System Team mit den Anforderungen der Organisation mitwächst und seine Wirkung laufend weiterentwickelt und gezielt ausdehnt.
### **Das bringst du mit** ###
* Du besitzt ein ausgezeichnetes Verständnis für moderne Softwareentwicklung, technische Plattformen und organisationsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit.
* Du denkst strategisch und bist gleichzeitig in der Umsetzung technisch wirksam.
* Du verstehst die Anforderungen moderner Softwareentwicklung und bringst fundierte, mehrjährige Erfahrung in Themen wie CI/CD, Automatisierung, Testing, Release-Management, Integration und DevOps mit - idealerweise aus komplexen Organisationen.
* Du bewegst dich sicher in anspruchsvollen IT-Landschaften - auch im Zusammenspiel von Standardsoftware, Eigenentwicklungen, Cloud-Services und On-Prem-Systemen.
* Du kannst eine klare Produkte-Vision erarbeiten und technische Themen strukturieren, priorisieren und in eine umsetzbare Roadmap übersetzen.
* Du agierst sicher in einem Umfeld mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern und schaffst es, gemeinsame Ziele und verbindliche Leitplanken zu etablieren und wirksam in einer Organisation zu verankern.
* Du denkst strategisch, bleibst aber in der Umsetzung pragmatisch und lösungsorientiert. Du erkennst, wo Standardisierung sinnvoll ist und wo Teams den nötigen Freiraum brauchen.
* Du beherrschst die deutsche Sprache und kommunizierst klar, adressatengerecht sowie überzeugend.

Neho est l'une des principales sociétés de courtage immobilier en Suisse, redéfinissant le secteur grâce à l'innovation. Nous combinons l'expertise humaine avec des solutions numériques puissantes pour offrir une expérience immobilière plus rapide, plus transparente et plus efficace.

Notre approche a été reconnue par des prix prestigieux, dont le SEF Award 2023. Ce qui nous distingue vraiment, c'est notre modèle à prix fixe, offrant aux clients une alternative moderne aux services traditionnels basés sur la commission, propulsée par une technologie avancée.
**Nous recherchons un ingénieur produit IA pour diriger, de manière pratique, la mise en œuvre de l'IA. Vous construirez les agents qui prennent en charge les parties manuelles et répétitives de l'achat, du financement et de la vente d'une maison, afin que nos experts puissent consacrer leur temps aux moments qui comptent.**
Vous ne partirez pas de zéro. Nous avons une vision convaincante et des prototypes fonctionnels. Votre mission est de faire passer ce modèle du prototype au produit : agents réels, utilisateurs réels, résultats mesurés. Vous mettrez en production un premier agent dans vos premiers mois et développerez un pipeline à partir de là.
**Il s'agit d'un rôle de zéro à un avec une véritable responsabilité et visibilité, relevant directement de notre CTO. Si vous aimez transformer un processus manuel en logiciel fonctionnel livré en semaines plutôt qu'en trimestres, vous vous sentirez chez vous ici.**
**Charge de travail : 80 - 100%**
## **Ingénieur Produit IA** ##
### **Vos tâches** ###
* **Trouver la valeur :** Passez du temps réel avec les chefs de produit, conseillers, agents immobiliers et spécialistes des opérations, cartographiez leurs flux de travail, identifiez les cas d'utilisation des agents qui éliminent le plus de travail mesurable tout au long du parcours client ou des opérations internes - priorisez par résultat
* **Construire les agents, de manière pratique :** Concevez, construisez, testez et déployez les agents vous-même : utilisez des frameworks et plateformes d'agents là où ils sont plus rapides, du code réel là où ils ne le sont pas
* **Assumer la livraison des interfaces :** Faites passer nos prototypes au produit, et faites évoluer la manière dont les agents atteignent les utilisateurs : dans le produit, en chat, puis plus tard sur mobile
* **Construire la couche MCP :** Enveloppez les API stables du domaine dans des outils MCP fins et bien conçus à travers lesquels vos agents agissent. Vous êtes le premier et le plus exigeant consommateur de notre architecture API-first.
* **Conduire les exigences vers les équipes :** Spécifiez les API dont vos agents et interfaces ont besoin auprès des équipes d'ingénierie propriétaires du domaine, qui les construisent et les exposent ; vous consommez des contrats propres plutôt que d'accéder directement aux systèmes
* **Choisir la plateforme avec l'équipe Platform :** Dirigez la sélection de la technologie et des plateformes conjointement avec l'équipe Platform, en tenant compte de la sécurité, de la protection des données suisse/UE, du coût et de l'opérabilité
* **Livrer sur rails, dans les limites :** Déployez sur le chemin cloisonné, containerisé et uniquement API de l'entreprise ; instrumentez et évaluez vos agents ; respectez les niveaux de sensibilité des données
* **Transférer quand un agent grandit :** Quand un agent devient critique pour les revenus ou touche des données client ou financières sensibles, transférez-le à l'ingénierie pour durcissement et prise en charge à long terme, et continuez à construire le suivant
* **Mesurer les résultats :** Suivez l'effort supprimé, le temps de cycle et l'impact sur la conversion, ainsi que l'adoption par les personnes servies par les agents. Pas le nombre d'agents livrés
#### **Ce que ce rôle n'est pas** ####
* **Pas le constructeur des API principales :** Les équipes d'ingénierie du domaine possèdent et exposent les API stables ; vous conduisez les exigences, construisez les fines enveloppes MCP par-dessus, et consommez les contrats
* **Pas le propriétaire de la plateforme/infrastructure :** La plateforme possède l'exécution, le déploiement, l'observabilité et la sécurité ; vous construisez par-dessus
* **Pas un service d'assistance IA :** Vous n'êtes pas là pour construire des outils sur mesure pour chaque département ; vous construisez les agents qui font avancer nos priorités, et aidez les autres à s'auto-servir en toute sécurité sur le chemin autorisé

* Profitez de hiérarchies plates, de processus décisionnels rapides, et de la liberté de travailler de manière autonome et de laisser votre empreinte
* Faites partie d'une équipe dynamique et tournée vers l'avenir, répartie entre nos bureaux de Lausanne et Zurich ainsi que notre équipe d'ingénierie à distance en Roumanie

### **Ce que vous apportez** ###
* **Maîtrise de la pile IA :** Vous avez travaillé avec la pile IA moderne sous une forme ou une autre (API directes de modèles, frameworks d'agents comme LangGraph/CrewAI/Google ADK, plateformes d'orchestration comme Dify/n8n). Ce qui compte, c'est ce que vous avez livré, pas l'outil utilisé.

s.h: Here-s the catch - du vereinigst zwei Widersprüche
s.t:
* Einerseits Ideation: Du denkst mutig und offen und schnell, bist kreativ und nimmst unerwartete Perspektiven ein. Damit findest und skizzierst du Lösungen, welche das Ordinäre sprengen.
* Andererseits arbeitest du strukturiert, logisch und mit einem Blick fürs Detail. Damit dokumentierst du deine Lösungen so, dass unsere technologiefernen Kunden sie verstehen und unsere Software-Entwickelnden diese umsetzen können.
* Du musst Menschen nicht lieben - aber ausgezeichnet mit ihnen umgehen können, locker und seriös gleichzeitig. Du kannst sie abholen, wo sie gerade sind und dahin führen, wo du sie begeistern kannst.
*Hintergrund*
* Du hast Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von (digitalen) Produkten, mit Business Analysis, Product Ownership oder Requirements Engineering.
* Datenmodellierung, Schnittstellendefinitionen, User Story Writing, Spezifikationen und Wireframing sind dein Werkzeugkasten.

* Keine Sorge, Französisch ist nicht nötig. Aber: Dein Deutsch ist ausgezeichnet und dein gesprochenes Englisch solide (ja, für alles Schriftliche gibt-s LLMs).
*Charakter*
* Du hast Bock, mit einem motivierten Team zusammen zu wachsen, dieses mitzuprägen und darin Verantwortung zu übernehmen.
* Du brüskierst dich an unklaren Ansagen und wirst ungeduldig bei langwierigen Meetings.
* Du erkennst Herausforderungen und gehst sie aktiv an. Du suchst und siehst Potential, nicht Probleme.
* Du willst nicht nur digitale Lösungen, sondern auch dich weiterentwickeln. Und im besten Fall die Agentur gleich mit.
**Und wieso gerade Helga?**
Du wirst Teil eines 11-köpfigen Teams - bist also keine Nummer, sondern ein Charakter. Wir sind konsensorientiert, arbeiten auf das gleiche Ziel hin und finden die beste Lösung gemeinsam.
Als Unternehmen und Personen entwickeln und bilden wir uns laufend weiter. Du kannst mitreden, deine Arbeit mitgestalten und unsere Zukunft prägen.

We encourage every member of the Remote team to bring their talents, experiences and culture to the table to help us build the best-in-class HR platform.
If you are energetic, curious, motivated and ambitious, be part of our world. Apply now and define the future of work!

Remote is solving a huge challenge for global organizations: compliantly employing anyone, anywhere. We make it possible for businesses to employ a global team by handling global payroll, benefits, taxes, and compliance (learn more about how it works ).
We're backed by A+ investors and our team is world-class, literally and figuratively - we're scattered around the world working together within a culture of kindness and excellence.
Please check out our public handbook to learn more about our culture. We encourage folks from all ethnic groups, genders, sexuality, age and abilities to apply. If this job description resonates with you, we want to hear from you!
How we work
While we love working async we have live interactions too. We aspire to minimize meetings and encourage you to create your own schedule based on when you're able to do your best work.
We empower ownership, proactivity, and default to action. We operate based on treating each other with kindness and support each other as a team.
The position
This is an exciting time to join Remote and shape a new business as the Senior Product Manager, Remote Build .
Remote Build is Remote's move on the agentic shift: as AI agents proliferate across HR and Finance stacks, they need to route through the employment infrastructure layer — labour law across 100+ countries, payroll, entity structures, the compliance rail.

Remote product teams develop the core; Remote Build delivers the rest with customers — deploying standard connectors, building bespoke ones, co-building custom apps and agents on top of Remote's APIs, MCP, and CLI, and running managed services after launch.

Founded in 2017, Wayve is the leading developer of Embodied AI technology. Our advanced AI software and foundation models enable vehicles to perceive, understand, and navigate any complex environment, enhancing the usability and safety of automated driving systems.
Our vision is to create autonomy that propels the world forward. Our intelligent, mapless, and hardware-agnostic AI products are designed for automakers, accelerating the transition from assisted to automated driving.
In our fast-paced environment big problems ignite us—we embrace uncertainty, leaning into complex challenges to unlock groundbreaking solutions. We aim high and stay humble in our pursuit of excellence, constantly learning and evolving as we pave the way for a smarter, safer future.
At Wayve, your contributions matter. We value diversity, embrace new perspectives, and foster an inclusive work environment; we back each other to deliver impact.
Make Wayve the experience that defines your career!

As Product Manager, AI Driver, based in our Germany office (London also considered), you will independently own a critical work package within Wayve's AI Driver product and lead a cross-functional team to deliver it end-to-end. You'll set the technical direction, drive priorities across engineering, AI research and program management.

You will rally the team around clear, ambitious goals. This is a high-ownership, high-impact role for someone who pairs deep AI technical depth with the interpersonal skills to listen, motivate and align brilliant teams toward shared outcomes.

Independently own a substantial work package end-to-end. Define the problem, set the strategy, sequence the work, and lead the team to ship outcomes that move the AI Driver product forward.
Lead a cross-functional team of engineers, researchers and PMs without formal authority. Give them clarity, remove blockers, and motivate them through hard, ambiguous problems.
Engage deeply with technical detail across AI / ML, autonomy and embodied AI. Debate trade-offs credibly with senior researchers and engineers, and bring structured thinking to complex technical decisions.
Translate R&D progress and customer needs into a clear product roadmap, sequencing capabilities to maximise impact and de-risk delivery.
Communicate crisply across audiences, from deep technical reviews with engineers, to executive updates with leadership, to customer-facing conversations.
Listen actively to engineers, partners and customers, and turn what you hear into better decisions and stronger team alignment.
Set, track and report on clear KPIs and milestones, and establish the operating rhythm the team needs to deliver.

In order to set you up for success as a Product Manager at Wayve, we’re looking for the following skills and experience.
Essential
Demonstrated ability to independently own a substantial work package and lead a cross-functional team to deliver it. You take outcomes personally and don't wait to be unblocked.
Strong technical depth, ideally in AI / ML, autonomy, robotics or another deep-tech domain, with the credibility to engage senior engineers and researchers as a peer.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. A careful listener, a clear writer, and someone who can motivate and energise a team through ambiguity.
Proven track record in product management, technical program management or a similar role on complex, cutting-edge technical products.
High autonomy, strong judgment and a bias for action. Comfortable making decisions with imperfect information and adjusting as you learn.
Desirable
Domain experience in autonomous driving, ADAS, automotive or other safety-critical product areas.
Hands-on background in AI / ML, for example research, applied ML, or shipping ML-powered products.
Background working across global teams (UK / EU ↔ US and Japan) in a startup or scale-up environment.
This is a full-time role based in our office in Leonberg. Civitas Learning is looking for a Senior Product Manager to drive the expansion of Compass AI into the next generation of AI-powered tooling, autonomous agents, and adaptive workflows.
This is a high-visibility, high-impact role focused on execution. Working in close partnership with the VP of Product, you will take a clear AI strategy and bring it to life: running discovery, building with engineering and data science, validating with customers, and shipping capabilities that measurably improve student outcomes at scale.
We are looking for someone who gets genuinely energized by figuring things out. Higher ed institutions are complex environments, and the people we serve (advisors, enrollment teams, financial aid staff) work in ways that are not always obvious from the outside. AI Product Execution
Execute against the Compass AI product roadmap in close collaboration with the VP of Product, translating strategic direction into well-scoped, deliverable work.
Identify and prioritize high-potential AI use cases across academic advising, enrollment, financial aid, retention, and student wellbeing, drawing on our library of 170+ agent concepts and emerging market signals.
Contribute to shaping the path from current-state tooling toward agentic, autonomous workflows, including multi-agent coordination, advisor copilots, and proactive outreach systems.
Surface findings, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly so the VP of Product and broader leadership can make informed decisions quickly.
Discovery & Validation

Spend meaningful time with advisors, enrollment counselors, financial aid staff, and other end users to understand how they work, what slows them down, and where AI can genuinely help. This is a collaborative, hands-on process and you will not be doing it alone.
Design and run pilots and prototype evaluations, synthesizing feedback to inform what to build next and where to course-correct.
Help develop and maintain a human-in-the-loop framework that ensures AI recommendations are actionable, trustworthy, and appropriately escalated.
Work Definition & Delivery
Translate strategy into clear, actionable work across engineering and design: epics, problem statements, user stories, and success criteria that give teams what they need to move without over-specifying implementation.
Maintain a clear, up-to-date view of what is in progress, what is coming next, and what is changing and why.

Partner closely with engineering to shape solutions, incorporate technical considerations early, and align on expectations before work begins.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Proactively communicate roadmap updates to Sales, Customer Success, and leadership so internal teams always know what is shipping and what is coming.
Collaborate with Legal, Compliance, and Customer Success to navigate institutional and regulatory considerations as new AI capabilities are introduced.
Partner with the go-to-market team to ensure AI capabilities are positioned and communicated in ways that land with higher ed audiences.
Platform & Agent Expansion
Support the expansion of Compass AI's agent library, including agent scope, trigger logic, escalation behavior, and intervention design across student success domains.

Direct experience with AI/ML products, including LLM-powered tools, conversational experiences, or autonomous agent systems, ideally in an enterprise or SaaS context.
Track record of executing effectively within a defined strategy. You know how to take direction, add your own insight, and move things forward.

Comfortable with ambiguity and genuinely motivated to figure things out, especially in a domain you are still learning.
Patient and empathetic with customers who are new to AI. Higher ed institutions move carefully and that is something to work with, not around.
Curious about AI in an ongoing way. You follow the space closely and bring informed perspective on what is hype vs. what is ready to ship.
Collaborative by default. You see the VP of Product as a close partner, not just a manager, and you bring your best thinking to that relationship.

* Mit deiner Expertise vertrittst du PromoPost in relevanten Fachgremien und pflegst die Zusammenarbeit mit wichtigen Partner:innen wie der Direct Mail Company.

* Produktbezogene Kundenanfragen zu technischen Informationen, Daten, Zertifikaten oder Verifizierungen bearbeiten.

### **V-ZUG Procurement** ###
Der Bereich Procurement verantwortet die strategische Beschaffung von Materialien, Komponenten und Dienstleistungen entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette. Als Schweizer Premiumhersteller mit eigener Produktion am Hauptsitz in Zug stellen wir hohe Anforderungen an unsere Lieferanten - und an uns selbst.

Unser Einkauf ist entsprechend professionell aufgestellt: mit klaren Kategorienstrukturen, einem internationalen Lieferantennetzwerk und dem Anspruch, nicht nur Kosten zu optimieren, sondern Partnerschaften zu gestalten, die langfristig tragen.
### **Das bietet dir die Stelle** ###
* Du entwickelst und setzt die Warengruppen- und Lieferantenstrategie für deine Kategorien um - nicht als Verwaltungsaufgabe, sondern als echte Gestaltungsaufgabe: Du entscheidest, welche Lieferanten V-ZUG langfristig begleiten, wo neue Quellen erschlossen werden und wie die Materialversorgung auch in einem volatilen Markt stabil bleibt
* Du steuerst dein Lieferantenportfolio über den gesamten Lebenszyklus - von der Auswahl neuer Partner über gezielte Weiterentwicklung bis zur Ausphasung. Gemeinsam mit dem Supplier Quality Management sorgst du dafür, dass Anspruch und Realität übereinstimmen - durch regelmässige Bewertungen und Audits, die mehr sind als ein Pflichtprogramm
* Du verantwortest das Vertragsmanagement in deinen zugewiesenen Warengruppen im Bereich Mechanik - von der Erstellung über die Verhandlung bis zur laufenden Pflege. Du weisst, was in einem Vertrag wirklich zählt, und bringst interne Stakeholder auf einen gemeinsamen Nenner
* Du führst Ausschreibungen durch, vergleichst Angebote und entwickelst gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen fundierte Vergabeempfehlungen und Entscheidungen, die wirtschaftliche und technische Anforderungen optimal vereinen
* Du hast die Kostenentwicklung deiner Vorserien- und Serienartikel im Griff: Du erkennst Potenziale frühzeitig, nutzt sie konsequent und setzt Massnahmen um, die nachhaltig wirken
* Du bist fester Bestandteil von Projekten, koordinierst Materialbedarfe mit Lieferanten und stellst sicher, dass Muster, Prototypen und Serienmaterialien dann da sind, wenn sie gebraucht werden

* Du weisst, wofür du stehst und bringst die Klarheit, Durchsetzungsstärke und Überzeugungskraft mit, um das auch zu zeigen: im internen Projektumfeld genauso wie im Gespräch mit externen Partnern
* Der sichere Umgang mit ERP-Systemen, insbesondere SAP, sowie digitalen Tools ist für dich selbstverständlich - kein Aufwand, sondern Arbeitsgrundlage
* Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch - schriftlich wie mündlich, klar und mit dem richtigen Gespür dafür, was dein Gegenüber braucht

About 9fin
9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.
Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.
Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.
We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.
The Opportunity
9fin has built one of the most comprehensive datasets in credit and debt markets: news, financials, cap tables, instrument data, legal documents, and ESG analysis. Today, most clients access that data through 9fin.com .

But a large and growing segment of the market wants to consume our data programmatically to power firm-level workflows at scale: a negative news signal triggers an automated credit review, updated financials trigger a portfolio rebalance, a covenant keyword triggers a sanctions flag.
These buyers (quant desks, data engineering teams, systematic investors, risk and compliance functions) will never log into a web application. They need APIs, data feeds, and cloud-native delivery through platforms like Snowflake. At comparable financial data providers, this distribution channel represents 20-30% of total revenue. 9fin is at the beginning of this journey.
The challenge is to turn 9fin's integrated dataset into a portfolio of standalone data products with a coherent commercial strategy.

You will define how the data gets packaged (what goes together, what stands alone, how it's tiered and priced), the order in which products go to market, and the commercial models that fit each buyer segment: quant desks, data engineering teams, risk and compliance functions, and systematic investors.

You will work in lockstep with the Head of Pre-Sales, who owns technical validation and deal execution, to ensure that what you build maps to how these buyers actually evaluate and procure data.

The first candidates pan news content, financials and cap tables, instrument data, and legal data (complex, high-value, and genuinely unsolved at the data representation layer).
You will work cross-functionally across our platform teams, analytics engineering, and the domain squads that own the underlying datasets. You will also work closely with Sales to support a fundamentally different GTM motion: solution-selling with partner clients, joint POCs, multi-stakeholder deals, and usage-based commercial models rather than seat-based subscriptions.
This is a 0-to-1 build. If you have built API or data products before and want to do it again in a market where the opportunity is wide open, this is it.

Product Strategy & Execution
Define the product vision and strategy for 9fin's external data distribution: APIs, data shares, and future delivery mechanisms (cloud sync, pub/sub).
Own the data catalogue decisions: which datasets to expose, in what format, through which channels, and in what order, balancing client demand, data readiness, and commercial potential
Design the developer experience end-to-end: API design, documentation, developer portal, sandbox/playground, error handling, rate limiting, and versioning
Work with analytics engineering and domain teams to define schemas, data models, and transformation logic that make 9fin's data consumable and valuable outside the application
Use a partner model to validate early: select and work closely with 1-2 clients during development to co-develop and prove out each data product before broader launch
Shape the commercial model for API products: packaging, tiering, usage-based pricing, distribution controls, and entitlement structures that capture the value of programmatic data access
Data Quality, Infrastructure & Compliance
Partner with the Head of Analytics to ensure data products meet the reliability, freshness, and accuracy standards that enterprise clients building automated systems expect
Define SLAs for data delivery (latency, uptime, completeness) and build the monitoring and metering infrastructure to back them up
Own the entitlements and access control layer: ensuring the right clients can access the right data under the right contractual terms, with appropriate usage limits and controls
Work with Legal to define data usage policies, including restrictions on redistribution, AI training and model embedding, and onward use, protecting 9fin's data IP while enabling legitimate client workflows
Establish feedback loops between API consumers and domain teams so that usage patterns and client requests improve the underlying data over time
Cross-Functional Leadership & GTM
Coordinate across platform engineering, analytics engineering, domain squads, and the Head of Analytics to align priorities and ship a cohesive product without a dedicated squad
Influence teams you do not manage; build relationships that make cross-functional delivery work despite competing priorities

Translate technical API and data infrastructure concepts into language that non-technical stakeholders (Sales, Legal, Finance) can act on

We’re on a mission to modernize insurance - making it simpler, more accessible, and customer-first. The insurance industry is a $1T market that’s remained largely untouched by the digital revolution, and PolicyMe is here to change that. As a remote-first, Toronto-based startup with big ambitions, we’re looking for a product leader to help us build the future of insurance in Canada - and beyond.
We are now seeking a Principal Product Manager to join our Accounts & Automation team within our product organization. This role will own several areas of scope, including:
Defining the strategy and roadmap to make us the go-to provider for all of our customers’ personal insurance needs, including the platform-wide programs and features that drive multi-product adoption
Building trust digitally across the products we offer, so customers feel similar levels of confidence and reassurance as they would get when they speak with one our licensed advisors
Evolving our accounts product and internal tools to streamline operations and deliver a seamless customer experience end to end.
This is a highly strategic and hands-on leadership role that blends product vision, analytical thinking, structured execution, and cross-functional leadership. You will be responsible for shaping long-term product direction while also driving day-to-day execution across multiple complex initiatives.

Reporting to the VP of Product, you will work closely with leaders across Engineering, Design, Growth, Operations, Customer Success, and Data to build products that create exceptional customer outcomes and drive meaningful business impact.
What you'll be doing
Define & Own the Product Vision
Evolve our product strategy to improve customer delight, retention, referral growth, operational efficiency, and cross-product adoption.
Develop a compelling long-term vision for how to make insurance simple for Canadians, from how customers discover new products of ours to how they manage it post-sale.
Build and champion a roadmap that balances innovation, operational excellence, and long-term scalability.
Develop a deep understanding of customer and operational pain points, using those insights to shape strategy and prioritization.
Establish clear OKRs and success metrics that align teams around measurable business and customer outcomes.
Solve Ambiguous Problems
Take open-ended, unstructured problems and break them down into clear opportunities, strategic priorities, and executable plans.
Bring creative, first-principles thinking to solve complex challenges that have not been solved before in the Canadian insurance market.
Balance customer needs, technical constraints, operational realities, and business priorities when making product decisions.
Lead through ambiguity and create clarity for teams and stakeholders across the organization.
Drive End-to-end Execution and Delivery
Lead the product team through the full product lifecycle: problem definition, discovery, solution design, scoping, execution, launch, and iteration.
While you’ll shape the strategic direction, you’re also highly execution-oriented and willing to dive into the details when needed.
Ensure we build the right things, the right way, at the right time by balancing short-term wins with long-term platform investments.
Collaborate closely with Product Design and Engineering to build best-in-class customer and internal product experiences.
Write clear, actionable product specifications that connect business goals, customer needs, operational requirements, and technical constraints.
Coordinate closely with Growth, Customer Success, Operations, and other stakeholders to ensure launches are operationally ready and well-supported.
Drive alignment across teams and act as the connective tissue between stakeholders with competing priorities.
Measurement, Experimentation and Iteration
Define success metrics and measurement frameworks for all major initiatives, including customer engagement, funnel conversion, retention, operational efficiency, and long-term customer value.
Design and run experiments to validate hypotheses, de-risk larger investments, and accelerate learning.
Partner closely with Data to build dashboards, analyze product performance, and translate insights into actionable next steps - including when to pivot, double down, or sunset initiatives.
Use data, customer insights, and business context to continuously refine strategy and prioritization.

8+ years of product management experience, including experience owning and scaling customer-facing digital products in high-growth environments.
Strong track record of leading complex cross-functional initiatives and delivering measurable business and customer outcomes.
Experience building both customer-facing D2C products and operational/internal tooling products.
Experience building prototypes with AI.
Experience scaling products and product practices within high-growth startups or fast-moving technology organizations.
Proven ability to define and communicate a compelling product vision that aligns teams and stakeholders around long-term outcomes.
Strong business acumen with a deep understanding of how product decisions impact revenue, operations, customer success, retention, and compliance.
Exceptional ability to structure ambiguous problems and turn them into clear, actionable plans.
Strong operational discipline with the ability to manage competing priorities, maintain momentum, and consistently close loops with stakeholders.
Excellent collaboration and stakeholder management skills with high emotional intelligence and a transparent leadership style.
Strong documentation and communication skills - able to tailor messaging effectively across executives, engineers, designers, marketers, and operational stakeholders.
Comfortable leading initiatives with many moving parts and driving alignment across multiple teams.
Strong sense of prioritization and ability to define MVP scope while balancing speed, quality, and long-term scalability.
Highly analytical and data-driven, with comfort working with product data, defining metrics, building measurement frameworks, and conducting analyses to inform decisions.

Generous PTO - 20 vacation days
A comprehensive benefits plan with premiums paid in full by PolicyMe
Investment in your professional development, including an L&D budget, AI tooling budget, performance reviews twice a year and ongoing feedback to ensure you reach your highest potential
An extremely high performing, low-ego, remote-first team that is truly disrupting an old industry
Option to work from home or our Toronto-based office (bonus: we cover the costs to bring all our employees in-person twice a year for experiential socials!)
Access to stock options based on performance
Additional Information

At PolicyMe, we are Canada’s leading digital insurance solution, offering straightforward and affordable financial protection for families from coast to coast. Our product suite includes Life Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, and Health & Dental Insurance, all tailored to Canadians' evolving needs.

We also offer B2B2C solutions, partnering with organizations to provide seamless digital insurance options. Founded by a team of insurance experts and technology entrepreneurs, PolicyMe is committed to making insurance simpler and more accessible.

Since our launch in 2018, we have grown exponentially, selling over $10 billion in insurance coverage to Canadians.

Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.
As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.
Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

Synthesia ships more product, faster, than we ever have. AI has collapsed the cost of building which means the hard part is no longer making things, it’s making sure people actually adopt them. That’s the job of Growth, and we’re changing how we do it: instead of bolting Growth on after launch to optimise, we’re embedding a Growth PM into every core bet from day one, so how a product acquires, activates and scales is designed in from the first cycle.
We’re hiring a Growth Product Manager to report to our VP of Growth. You'll own the Growth surface for one of those bets while helping build a growth-led way of working across the company.
What you’ll be doing

Primer is the unified infrastructure for global payments. We give finance and payments teams the visibility and control to reduce complexity, improve performance, and capture more revenue - all from a single platform.

Which team will you be joining?
Getting paid is only half the story. Understanding and managing those payments is where the real work begins.
In the Financial Operations team we build the tools and infrastructure that let merchants take control of their payments: reconciling funds, monitoring performance, and automating the operations that keep everything running. We also own Global Accounts, giving merchants the ability to hold, manage and move funds across currencies and markets, a foundational capability as Primer expands into more complex, cross-border payment environments.
The team spans Reconciliation, Operations Automation, Global Accounts and FX. As a Product Manager here you will own a sub-area within that: a coherent slice of the product where you own the problems, the prioritisation and the outcomes over multiple quarters.
You will work day to day with a dedicated engineering team and design partner, alongside GTM, and report into the Product lead for the area. Primer is remote-first and globally distributed, and always will be. We run on written thinking, low bureaucracy and real ownership. You build it, you own it, end to end.
What will you be doing?
Owning the outcomes for your sub-area of Financial Operations over multiple quarters, not just shipping a backlog
Defining the problems worth solving in your scope by synthesising merchant feedback, support data, competitive moves and platform constraints
Planning and delivering initiatives independently, making real-time trade-offs on scope, sequencing and quality to protect both timelines and outcomes
Writing specs that anticipate the edge cases that actually matter in payments operations: reconciliation breaks, currency and settlement complexity
Partnering closely with engineering on feasibility and technical trade-offs, and defining the leading and lagging metrics that tell you whether your sub-area is working
Owning launch readiness and driving rapid post-launch iteration based on what the data shows
Representing your sub-area to merchants and internal stakeholders, turning operational complexity into clear product decisions

A track record of owning a product sub-area or significant feature set end to end, with outcomes that can be traced back to your decisions
The ability to define problems independently from messy inputs, rather than waiting for a fully formed brief
Sound, autonomous trade-offs on scope, quality and technical debt within your scope
Enough technical fluency to partner with engineers on feasibility and integration implications, not just hand over requirements
Clear, structured communication that keeps engineering, design and GTM aligned and surfaces risks early

Experience in payments, fintech, or operational and back-office product such as reconciliation, ledgers, treasury or FX
Comfort with data analysis to define and track outcome metrics
You may not like it here
Financial operations is detail-heavy and unforgiving. Reconciliation and FX have real money and real edge cases attached. If you prefer broad, abstract product work to getting the details exactly right, this will frustrate you.
You are expected to define what is worth solving in your sub-area, with support rather than direction.
We are remote-first and async by default. If you need people physically around you to do your best work, this is a real adjustment, not a perk.
Feedback here is direct and frequent. You are expected to give it as well as take it.

You'll own one of Letly's product surfaces end to end — the money surface (rent collection, deposits, landlord payouts, statements and the ledger underneath them) or the marketplace (AI-Native property management, the vendor network and the embedded products sold into a tenancy) — the product and the operation running on it.
We don't sell software to this industry, we run the industry ourselves: every product decision you make lands in a real tenancy, a real payment and a real operator's day, usually within the week.
These are mid-to-senior hires. At mid you own a surface and ship it. At senior you own a surface others depend on — you set the product patterns, take the architecture-shaped calls with engineering, and raise the bar around you.
What you'll own
The console the business runs on. The internal surface ops actually works in, whichever side you own. Every hour of manual work you design out is margin.

Rent in. Collection across thousands of tenancies — mandates, retries, part-payments and arrears — and the tenant-facing product wrapped around it.
Money out. Landlord payouts, statements, deposits and pooled client money: right to the penny, on the day we promised, compliant, and legible to a landlord who is not an accountant.
The ledger and reconciliation. A penny-accurate, self-healing ledger reconciling bank activity across every tenancy, plus the tooling ops reaches for when it doesn't match.
Money agents in production. Agents that chase arrears, answer "where is my rent", and escalate to a human. You decide what they're allowed to do, what the guardrails are, and where the handover sits.

AI-Native property management. The managed product itself — maintenance, compliance, renewals, inspections — run by agents with humans only on the exceptions, across the service ladder from self-managing to guaranteed.
The vendor network. Supply on the services side: contractors, engineers, cleaners, inventory clerks, photographers. Onboarding, pricing, SLAs, quality controls, and the routing that picks the right one without a human in the middle.
Embedded products. Insurance, compliance certificates, referencing and utilities sold into the tenancy at the moment they're needed — attach rate, take-rate and the unit economics of each.
The landlord and tenant journey. Listing → viewing → offer → referencing → contract → tenancy → renewal, built as one product across both sides of a transaction that has never been one product.
How we work
You get your own answers — query the data, read the tickets, sit with ops, do the job manually once before you specify it.
You use AI across your own work: research, specs, prototypes, analysis. We expect a PM to operate AI-Natively and run product operations.
Weekly release cadence, decisions written down, evidence over opinion.

3+ years owning product end to end in a high-growth environment (more, for senior), including at least one thing you launched from zero.
Technical range: you can intelligently discuss system design, APIs, data models and failure modes, and engineers respect your judgement.
You do your own analysis — you're comfortable in the data and you prioritise on expected impact, not on who asked.
Operational literacy: you can design a process and a product together, and you know which of the two is the right fix.
AI-Native: you use models expertly, and you can specify an agentic product — scope, guardrails, evals and failure modes included.
Depth in one of our two surfaces: either a payments, lending, insurance or banking product you owned — treating reconciliation, failure paths and regulatory constraints as product problems rather than edge cases — or supply or demand in a two-sided marketplace, with liquidity, matching, take-rate and the quality controls that keep both sides coming back.
Senior: a track record of owning a surface others depended on, and of raising the standard of the people around you.

Exposure to the other surface — money if you come from marketplaces, marketplaces if you come from money.
Property or lettings experience.
First PM into a company, or a technical degree / having shipped code yourself.
Who does well here
You own the number, not the roadmap — the roadmap is a means to it.
You go to the operation — the answer is in the property, the call recording and the ledger, not in the backlog.
You decide — with incomplete information, in writing, and you revisit when the evidence changes.
You compress — you'd rather delete a step than design a screen for it.
Why apply
Letly is the AI-Native operating company built for the home. We believe the home will be autonomously run by AI and we're building the software that will run all rental properties end-to-end, starting with London (the world's 2nd largest rental city).
You'll get to own the whole loop: build the software, run the operation on it, and watch the unit economics move. You own the output metric, not just the process. The domain is the largest financial relationship in most people's lives and for the first time in history, technology enables us to crack it. The surface you own will be one of the first parts of it to run itself.
We've raised a $4m pre-seed from investors who've built the financial and operational infrastructure that moves billions and serves millions. They backed us because the home is the largest consumer asset where that infrastructure hasn't been built yet. You'll get competitive base pay, meaningful equity, and a small, high-agency team rebuilding an industry and growing at >100% month-over-month. We're hiring to facilitate this aggressive growth.
