s.h: HELP US HELP THE WORLD AGREE FASTER
s.t:
Juro has big ambitions: to become the go-to platform for agreeing and managing contracts globally. And we'll need help doing it.
Legal tech is on the rise, with Goldman Sachs estimating that 44% of legal tasks can be automated with generative AI. With the brand we have built and the agility of early stage we are well placed to capture this opportunity.
Signing a contract is the easy part. Everything before it (multiple parties, several legal documents, opposing interests, a redlining process most companies still run through email attachments) is where contracting actually gets hard.
That's the part of Juro you'll own. It's the most ambitious area of the product and the one with the most room to change how contracting feels for the people doing it day to day.
We're not handing you a blank page. There's a roadmap in place and a team ready to build it. We want you shipping against it while you're forming your own view of the problem, then tell us which parts of it were wrong.
Every PM at Juro is hired to make product bets that pay out . Great means that:
the bets you own deliver real outcomes for customers quickly, and
those outcomes show up in revenue.

Ship against the contract workflow roadmap in your first few weeks.
Get close to the problem rapidly. Talk to customers and prospects yourself. Form your own view of the jobs to be done rather than inheriting ours.
Take on AI review. It's a deep agentic system (evals, flows, failure modes) and "good redline" isn't a pass/fail, which is what makes it hard. It also spans your team and our Agentic team, so some of what you own won't sit neatly in one place.
Work shoulder to shoulder with engineering, design and GTM to turn all of that into something people actually enjoy using.
Measure whether any of it worked and be honest when it didn't. Iterate or pivot when necessary.
Six months in, success looks like customers telling us unprompted that contracting in Juro got a lot more delightful and reaching for it in places they used to reach for Word.
We care about building a diverse team where everyone feels they belong. That’s why our perks & benefits and choice-first work approach are designed with inclusivity in mind. Read more in our diversity, inclusion & belonging hub .

Research shows that while men apply to jobs if they meet ~60% of criteria, women and those in traditionally under-represented groups tend to apply only if they check all boxes. So if you think you have what it takes but don't meet every single point above, please still get in touch. We'd love to have a chat and see if you could be a great fit.

Every Juror finds their balance across our four core principles — we hire, develop and celebrate people who live them every day.
Curious how you’d fit? Try our personality quiz to see how you map against our principles.

At Tessl, we are building the context layer for AI coding agents, and a platform for AI-native software development. As an early member of the team, you’ll help shape how we build, scale and support a company operating at the edge of AI and software development.

We're looking for a Member of Product Staff — a senior, hands-on product manager who can own ambiguous, high-stakes problems end to end and help define how product is practised as the team grows.
This is a generalist role. The patterns for how developers work with AI agents are still forming, and you'll have a direct hand in shaping them across the product — from the CLI and core platform to the new bets we'll place as we expand. Much of the work is 0-to-1: you'll shape product direction amid genuine ambiguity, translate fast-moving model and research breakthroughs into experiences developers trust, and decide what's worth building when there's no settled playbook.
We also expect this person to be building a genuinely AI-native product practice: using the best available tools to think more clearly, move faster, and raise the quality of the work. We're not looking for someone who uses AI occasionally — we want someone actively developing how they work with it, and setting the standard for the team.
What you'll work on
Own product areas end to end. Take problems from early concept through discovery, definition, launch, and iteration — setting priorities for a cross-functional team and making the calls on what matters most.
Develop deep product sense for developer workflows. Spend real time with developers and engineering teams to understand how they think, where they struggle, and where AI creates the most leverage. Turn those observations into specific, well-reasoned product decisions.
Translate frontier capability into product. Partner closely with engineering and research to turn new model capabilities and agentic breakthroughs into reliable, high-value developer experiences.
Shape strategy, not just execute it. Bring a clear point of view to roadmap and direction. You'll be in the room for strategy conversations and expected to help shape outcomes, not just respond to decisions already made.
Lead through influence. Act as the connective tissue between engineering, design, research, GTM and leadership — and as a credible voice with customers. Keep a globally-minded, fast-moving team rowing in the same direction.
Maintain a high quality bar at speed. Ship quickly without losing rigour, and hold the line on quality and developer trust even when the product is changing fast.
Build an AI-native product process. Define which tools and workflows raise quality and pace, share what you learn, and help set how product gets done at Tessl.

Experience: Roughly 6+ years in product management (or equivalent), with a track record of shipping real, technically demanding products end to end. Comfortable operating at a senior IC level with significant autonomy.
Product sense & judgment: Strong instincts for what to build and why, backed by good business judgment and the ability to reason clearly under ambiguity and incomplete information.
Technical fluency: A track record of building for technically sophisticated users — developers, engineers, or data professionals. You don't need to be an engineer, but you should be genuinely curious about how the systems you build for actually work, and able to partner with research and engineering at a technical level.
0-to-1 instinct: Comfortable shaping direction where there's no settled product, market, or process. You're drawn to ambiguity rather than unsettled by it.
Collaboration & communication: Excellent communicator who can align and influence engineers, designers, researchers and leaders who think differently to you. Confident enough to hold a point of view, flexible enough to run with the best idea wherever it comes from.
Domain experience (a plus): Developer tools, AI/ML applications, or productivity infrastructure. Exposure to CLI tooling, agentic workflows, or evaluation systems is a genuine advantage.
We don't have all the answers yet. This is a role where you'll help define new patterns, work at the edge of what's known, and shape how product is practised at a company still figuring things out in the best possible way. This role combines product management with customer experience research, conductingmarket and usability research and developing adoption strategies to support successfulproduct launches and long term user retention.
What does a day in the life of a Product Manager look like?
Own and define product features and roadmap, ensuring alignment with business goals and the customer journey.
Design and execute market research and competitive analysis to identify market gaps, user personas, and emerging customer needs.
Conduct customer discovery, user interviews, and usability testing to identify friction
points and validate prototypes before development.
Develop onboarding flows and adoption strategies to support user acquisition and product adoption.
Partner with Engineering, UX/UI Designers, Customer Success, and Marketing to translate customer insights into feature specifications (PRDs) and user stories.
Lead the creation and maintenance of product documentation, including feature specifications, release notes, and SOPs for internal teams.
Define, track, and analyze key product metrics (e.g., CAC, LTV, churn, DAU/MAU, NPS) to inform feature iteration.
Partner with customer-facing teams to deliver product enablement training, ensuring support staff are aligned with the customer journey.
Adhere to company policies and procedures
Meet or exceed performance targets for related KPIs
Continuously improve knowledge of product management methodologies, customer experience research, and industry best practices through training and learning initiatives
Collaborate with other departments as needed
Maintain a positive, empathetic, and professional attitude toward customers and colleagues at all times

Are you looking for an exciting Product Management opportunity in one of the fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups in the Netherlands? Then look no further.
Your job
As the Product Manager for the Core AI team, you are responsible for enabling our customers to harness the power of AI directly within Channable.
We have already taken big steps by successfully automating feed setup workflows for major advertising platforms like Google and Meta, but this is just the beginning. Your focus will be extending these intelligent capabilities across complex e-commerce marketplaces, with major channels like Bol.com and Amazon serving as examples of what’s next on the roadmap.
Your main goal is to leverage AI to eliminate manual friction, automate repetitive user tasks, and radically elevate the user experience. By making feed mapping and categorization effortless through AI, your team will play a direct role in solving one of our biggest product objectives: radically reducing the time to value for customers expanding into new sales channels.
Your challenges
Translate customer insights into clear product strategies, user-centric features, and well-defined roadmap items.
Proactively identify opportunities to leverage AI, finding innovative ways to automate repetitive workflows and eliminate setup friction.
Lead the full product development lifecycle, guiding features from discovery through design to delivery.
Write clear specifications and collaborate daily with Engineers, Product Designers, and QA to ensure AI features are both powerful and seamless to use.
Foster an empowered, collaborative environment that aligns AI innovation with Channable’s broader business goals.
Serve as an internal and external thought leader on how AI can empower our customers.
Who are you?
You have at least 3 years of experience as a Product Owner or Product Manager, ideally in a B2B SaaS company.
Familiarity with solving technical problems that strengthen customer-facing features.
A proven track record of bringing solutions from 0-1 and iterating based on feedback.
Demonstrable experience with product discovery, design, and delivery activities.
Demonstrated ability to think strategically and anticipate future opportunities and challenges. You should also be able to bring internal stakeholders along on the journey, securing enthusiasm and support for your identified opportunities.
Experience working in an e-commerce platform company or in a company within the e-commerce industry is a strong plus.
Experience working with 3rd-party integrations and APIs is a strong plus.
You have excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

EU citizenship or a valid work permit for the Netherlands; you are preferably already living in the Netherlands.
Available for at least 32 hours a week, with two days spent at the Utrecht office.
Important note: we understand that studies show women may only apply for roles when they feel they meet 100% of the requirements; therefore, we strongly encourage you to apply even if you don't check every box, as we are looking for passionate individuals with potential and a willingness to grow.
Your team
You will lead the product strategy for our dedicated Core AI team, working alongside talented Machine Learning Engineers and Fullstack Engineers, as well as collaborating closely with Product Designers and QA to ensure our intelligent features are both intuitive and rock-solid.
While your team focuses on building smart, proprietary models under the hood, you won't work in isolation. You will collaborate with Product Managers across other domains to ensure AI functionality is seamlessly embedded into the broader user journey.
Who are we?
Channable was founded in 2014 in the heart of Utrecht and is a fast-growing B2B SaaS platform that offers a fully integrated way to market your products online. We empower marketers and online businesses to manage, scale, and optimize their marketing. We are now a strong team of 320+ diverse individuals from more than 40+ nationalities.
Joining Channable means you’re looking for a bit more than just a job. Diverse as we are, we all share our love for growth, helping, taking ownership, and creating an awesome journey together. Feel free to take a further look at who we are here and on our Instagram or LinkedIn! Wanna get to know us even more? Give our Culture Playbook a read.
Why Channable?
At Channable, you’ll find a culture that values openness, craftsmanship, and collaboration. We invest in our people and give them the autonomy to drive meaningful change. You'll work on technical challenges that matter, with colleagues who care deeply about the product and each other.
Want to read more about our development adventures? Then visit our inspiring tech blog: https://tech.channable.com/
And if this makes you enthusiastic, you can also take a look at some of our open-source work at https://github.com/channable to get a feeling for how we work together and what our code looks like.

Senior Product Manager.
About Product Management.
Our Product Management community establishes harmony between the conceptual and the pragmatic - linking product strategy and development to the overall business vision from discovery through delivery. Our teams are laser focused on the needs and behaviors of consumers and users while ensuring alignment to business objectives.

We collaborate closely with other disciplines to define the strategic product vision, initiate product planning, manage implementation, drive delivery and lead ongoing iterations & optimization.
Job description.
Huge is looking for a Senior Product Manager to join the Product Management craft. In this role, you will collaborate closely with cross-functional crafts to define the core product vision, goals, functionality, and requirements while establishing a shared set of objectives by building collective consensus on priorities leading to product delivery and beyond.
What you’ll be doing.
Define and manage product roadmaps to realize business goals and strategies.
Collaborate with user experience experts, visual designers, and engineers to reach the best possible version of a feature to bring to market.
Create and maintain feature backlogs, and product documentation such as PRDs, user stories, use cases, user flows, logic flows, and functional specifications.
Prioritize development activities with engineering teams, assist in determining the best technical implementation methods, work closely with QA on acceptance testing, and lead product launches.
Validate & identify strategic opportunities through research, data analysis, A/B testing, competitive research and other relevant tools.
Act as the voice of the user and key stakeholders during day to day aspects of product development.
Help define and refine working processes in order to maximize efficiency in constantly evolving environments.
Mentor and manage team members.
Participate in a culture of learning and growing.
What we’d like to see.
Product expertise, including analyzing business problems, and working to prioritize and create engaging experiences.
A natural understanding of technology and how to use it to achieve outstanding products.
Experience with agile methodologies, and an understanding of roles + responsibilities in various development methodologies.
User/Client/Colleague empathy.
The ability to work across multiple projects and balance competing priorities.
Clear communication skills and storytelling ability with the emotional intelligence to adjust your style based upon your audience.
A systems thinker who is proactive rather than reactive - putting principles first.
Experience using measurable approaches to introduce solutions.
Experience analyzing metrics and summarizing into relevant insights.
Cross-functional collaboration - willing to work across multiple crafts (Creative, Data & Analytics, Technology, Program, etc.).
Strong appreciation for design and user experience.
At least 5+ years of experience in Product Management

Toast is driven by building a platform that helps our customers adapt, take control, and get back to what they do best: building the businesses they love. From independent operators to global enterprise chains with thousands of locations, Toast powers the full guest and operator experience — point of sale, kitchen display, payroll, analytics, and beyond.

In this highly visible role, you will define what gets built, in which system, with what sequencing and you hold the accountability for delivery across all of it.

Define pricing, packaging, and go-to-market strategy with Product Marketing, Sales, and Operations; identify commercial models that fit restaurants of different sizes.
Coach senior PMs and engineers on product development and vendor evaluation.
